name: Heretic's Molten Blade
desc: He drew this weapon once more when he first met that God of Flame, revered by all, but it had been too long since he had last used it.

desc.text:
When the newly-born flames yet boiled over with steam, and were by them lifted through the seared and pockmarked rocky strata,
After he had dismissed the attendants, and none but he remained in the royal hall, he ceased half-kneeling before the empty throne and stood up.
The sword he drew from the leather scabbard had gone unused for so long that its edge had lost the keenness it once possessed.
However, its owner had taken good care of it, allowing not a speck of dust to sully it across these decades.
In truth, he was no swordsman, for the half of his blood that he hated had conferred upon him strength too far beyond the common clay.
All knew that he had mastered the golden language and could command the rainbow light to a nigh-magical degree, but none knew that he could fight a dragon with his bare hands.
The timing of his coming into possession of this weapon, too, was a tad strange. After the many heroes had swept through a certain stronghold of draconic descendants,
Everyone lit a bonfire amidst the bones and broken mechanisms, and within a few cups had lost any sense of proportion in their speech.
"Everyone knows the best weapon to use against giant beasts is a large two-handed sword! Just watch the creature's movements and BAM! One good hit, and even the hardest skull would be ringing like a bell for half a day."
"Hah. If my venom-tipped arrows hadn't sunk deep into their hides and bones, you couldn't ever have gone for their dumb heads. You can barely put your right foot in front of your left most days!"
"This one proposes that Ixquieh did the most work, luring them into our trap as she did using Phlogiston. Their automaton soldiers had their weaknesses exposed to us for a good while on her account."
"Nah, you did good too, elder brother. Dodging those claw-swipes, swirling and cutting in mid-air one-handed, and all that. Why, you even got onboard one of those dragons and crashed its head into the cliff face, didn't you?"
"Help. Help! Someone get me ticket out of hearing these siblings blow each others' horns! I'd rather hear Maghan play the flute."
"If you think me a poor player, Uenuku, why don't you cover your ears, hmm? It's not as if I can control your arms."
"You know what? We need a judge! That's what we need! Someone to pick the best weapon!" Thus did the raucous crowd turn their eyes toward the red-haired man carrying the meat.
Sealing the mouths of the noisy drunkards shut with the grilled meat, he looked at the one who stood in the shadows. "The best weapon, huh..."
The man who could use all weapons, naturally, could not give everyone a satisfactory answer, but when the man with the flaming hair turned his gaze upon him,
Ah, he thought to himself, so that was it. Indeed, surely it could only be so. He was himself the other's most perfect weapon. How could it be otherwise?
"By the way, you've gone without weapons all this time, right? So, what do you want to use? Whatever you pick... We'll take that to be the best weapon!"
It was only later that he discovered that this was one of that man's aggravating habits — throwing ridiculous questions at bystanders. At any rate, he made his decision...
His answer likely only pleased Ahpub and that man who now did not need to answer a troublesome question.
The latter fulfilled said promise, and it was a deed rich with meaning indeed — fire was brought forth to smelt the works of the ancient dragons, and from them a sharp blade was made for him.
"It's standard practice to make weapons of war from materials we gather from our hunts."
"Give it a try. The material and center of gravity have all been tuned to your proportions."
A weapon gifted by that man could never perform poorly. Many times would he use himself as bait, and use this blade to cut off the bewildered foe's heads.
He swore to use this blade to hunt down all the inhuman heretics, to create a realm belonging only to humans for the one who had given him this sword.
But it had been too long since he had last wielded this sword in battle, and he was never very good at it anyway.
The crimson-eyed young man's face, yet-immature but wrathful, flashed before him with a might not unlike a god's,
And the sword that once slew heretics was wrenched from his hand, and then was thrust into his breast even as he teetered on the brink, about to fall into the mud.
He watched the other party as his body sank into the pitch-black mire.
"Hah... That's right. I see now. It... could only be thus."
Before he closed his eyes, he looked upon the red-eyed young man's flames for a moment,
And lo, he took it for the shadow of the cunning crimson fox, face filled with sorrow, flashing across the corner of the collapsing palace.

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: Blazing Sacrificial Heart's Terror
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
According to ancient tribal tradition, all that a person takes comes from this world — so naturally, all that they gain shall also be given back to it.

materials.name: Cold-Cracked Shellshard
materials.desc:
A chunk of shell carved from a Furnace Shell Mountain Weasel's back after its defeat.
Where it once blazed brightly, this piece has long since gone cold. The fire-like luster it once held is no more.

materials.name: Sentry's Wooden Whistle
materials.desc:
The symbol of a Natlan tribal sentry.
Warriors are not born as warriors. They must first acquire the skills of combat by learning under the tutelage of those who have already done so. This is the origin of the trainee position of sentry.

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: Blazing Sacrificial Heart's Hesitance
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
After the original civilizations crumbled like shattered jade — and those envoys from the skies above, under whose guidance the earthly civilizations had thrived, were devoured by the awakened dragons — humanity plunged into savagery, losing the ability to perceive the world anew.
Thus did they revert to their most primal beliefs, convinced of the inherent mystery of the earth that nurtured all things. This marked the dawn of the era where hunted prey began to be offered as sacrifices.

materials.name: Warm Back-Shell
materials.desc:
A portion of shell removed from a Furnace Shell Mountain Weasel's back after its defeat.
Furnace Shell Mountain Weasels accumulate Phlogiston in their shells from feeding to be used in emergencies. The sight of them blazing fiery trails over the Sacred Mountain has not been seen since ancient times.

materials.name: Warrior's Metal Whistle
materials.desc:
The symbol of a Natlan tribal warrior.
A metal whistle that is given to individuals who have been officially recognized as tribal warriors. It is used to communicate and alert others to danger by those that patrol the tribe's vicinity. This is a duty that falls upon the warriors of the tribe.

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: Blazing Sacrificial Heart's Resolve
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
It is said that the Sage of the Stolen Flame, after imparting the secret knowledge of the mastery of flames in all their many forms to the tribespeople, hoped that they would climb the ladder of civilization and abandon the wrongful practices of their forebears.
Yet dogma deeply entrenched is difficult indeed to shake, and the now empowered youngsters instead ignited conflicts within their own tribes merely for the sake of more offerings. This may explain the sage's eventual disillusionment and withdrawal from history.
Notably, it was precisely during the reign of the Sacred Lord of the ineffable city that the practice of offering live sacrifices was banned outright. Though the Sacred Lord's true motivation for abolishing many of their customs was the consolidation of authority, this particular act might also be seen as the start of a new kind of civilization.

materials.name: Blazing Prismshell
materials.desc:
A whole piece of radiant shell liberated from a Furnace Shell Mountain Weasel's back after its defeat.
It is said that the more Phlogiston a Furnace Shell Mountain Weasel has stored in its back, the higher its status in the pack. The reasoning for this phenomenon may be quite simple: More dominant Furnace Shell Mountain Weasels likely have less need to call on their Phlogiston reserves than their less prominent peers.

materials.name: Saurian-Crowned Warrior's Golden Whistle
materials.desc:
Among Natlan's tribes, this is the symbol of a mighty, Saurian-Crowned warrior.
A golden whistle that is bestowed only upon those who have won great honor for the tribe and shown valor of the highest order. Its symbolic significance now outweighs its practical use, for a Saurian-Crowned warrior is able to handle most crises alone.

materials.name: Blazing Sacrificial Heart's Splendor
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
"If you wish to possess all that the world has to offer, you must first offer all you have to the world."
After the Sacred Lord of the ineffable city forbade the people from praying to the Night Kingdom, the spiritual bonds that had once been established fell into ruin.
The scarlet-eyed youth, guided through numerous trials, now faced his final test: to emulate the first human to ascend and confront his own demise by offering up his heart with a golden dagger.
Self-sacrifice was seen as an honor reserved for the victor — and thus, without even a moment's hesitation, he sliced open his chest with the gleaming blade.
In the end, his sacrifice received the response it deserved, and he was able to return from the kingdom where water flows as rays of light to set out upon a grand new endeavor.

customize.text: After unlocking Gnostic Hymn and reaching BP Level 30, you can select a weapon of your choice from the BP Bounty

customize.name: Forged by the Golden Melody
customize.desc: A greatsword decorated in gold. Legend has it that it was the favored weapon of a certain exalted Harmost back in the distant past.

customize.name: Frostbreath
customize.desc: A spear of solid ice imbued with an icy chill. It is said that it once belonged to the Belyi Tsar who ruled Snezhnaya in the distant past.

customize.name: Clash of Kings
customize.desc: A golden box lavishly inlaid with precious jewels. It houses a game much beloved by the kings of the sands.

customize.name: Jade Vista
customize.desc: A longbow of immense strength. It shines with the radiance of dreams even in the darkest of nights.

value.text:
Battle Pass - Gnostic Hymn
BP Bounty

After the equipping character uses their Elemental Skill, they gain "Gleam of First Light." While active, Gleam of First Light tracks their distance traveled. Each second, the equipping character gains an ATK Bonus ranging from <color=#36ffff>18%/22.5%/27%/31.5%/36%</color> to <color=#36ffff>36%/45%/54%/63%/72%</color> based on the distance traveled during the previous second. Gleam of First Light lasts 14s, can be triggered once every 14s, and is removed when the equipping character leaves the field.
